* Don't drive, ride or walk through flood water.
* Keep clear of creeks and storm drains.

text.p: Check https://www.bom.gov.au/weather-and-climate/warnings-and-alerts. Warnings are also available through TV and Radio broadcasts or call 1300 659 210. The Bureau and State Emergency Service would appreciate warnings being broadcast regularly.

forecast-period.text: A line of severe thunderstorms is producing areas of heavy rainfall to the northeast of Ceduna.

text.p: Weather Situation: A line of thunderstorms has developed to the north of Ceduna. The storms are moving slowly to the east and southeast and may persist throughout the morning.
Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce heavy rainfall that may lead to flash flooding in the warning area over the next several hours.
